digest.component_or_area: code-review gate dispatch and criteria routing
propositions: Project code-review criteria's applies_to field is stored but never validated or read during dispatch, causing criteria to run on every review regardless of changed files
applies_to validation is missing in _validate_routing_entry at overlay load, allowing malformed values (non-list, non-string elements, bare strings) to silently fail instead of raising errors
_activated_code_review_project_criteria filters only on criterion_id prefix and exec type, never checking applies_to globs against changed files, unlike plan-review which gates on file impact
Globs from packaged routing_index() are never matched for project criteria because they iterate only the closed OVERLAY_IDS enum which project. ids cannot join
applies_to with empty list must mean always-on for project criteria (opposite to built-in overlay semantics of escalation-only), creating a semantic collision that must be documented
